question.text: SEBI PM Regs require mandatory appointment of which of these officers?

answer.text: Principal Officer and Compliance Officer (distinct from each other)

explanation.text: The Logic: PM Regs: Principal Officer (investment decisions + regulatory interface) and Compliance Officer (independent compliance function) — must be distinct individuals. The Trap: Combining into one person is forbidden — independence is the point. Cross-Exam Context: XXI-A Topic 7; XXI-B expects deeper recall. Manager's Pro-Tip: Fund Manager and Dealer roles are additional — maintain clear segregation of duties in dealing-room workflows.
